name: IsoOctree
definition: An unconstrained isosurface extraction method on arbitrary octrees. It computes the Euclidean Distance Transform (EDT) of an input mesh, adapts an octree to sample the EDT (finer near the surface), and computes the zero-crossing isosurface.
summary: IsoOctree extracts isosurfaces from arbitrary octrees using Euclidean distance transforms, enabling adaptive mesh simplification without strict grid constraints.
